# 🤖 OpenThrottle | AI

OpenThrottle is an open-source, AI-native platform for planning and shipping software. Plans, tasks, docs, agent runs and commits live in one Postgres-backed system that your editor, your agents and your team all share over MCP. You choose a runner, shape it to how your team works, and run it on your own machine. Every run is recorded as history, and that history feeds the next plan, so the system gets better with each iteration.

### 🧠 Plans as shared memory

Plans, tasks, notes and repo docs in one knowledge base with hybrid search, available in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Antigravity over MCP.

- 📋 **[Plans and tasks](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/databases/openthrottle/README.md)**: Durable plans and tasks with a real lifecycle, not Markdown files that drift.
- 🧠 **[Knowledge search](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/databases/openthrottle/README.md)**: Hybrid search over plans, tasks, notes and repo docs, grounded in what your team shipped.
- 🔌 **[MCP in every agent CLI](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/openthrottle/mcp-registration.md)**: One MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Antigravity, with the same permissions in each.
- 🧩 **[Shared skills](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/Skills.md)**: Skills, rules and prompts in one place, shared with every agent tool and promoted when they are ready.

### 🔁 Runners you own

Start from strong runners and loops, then customize them. Runs get isolated worktrees and can be queued or scheduled; any agent CLI does the work.

- 🔁 **[Customizable runners](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/workflows/ot-loop-job.md)**: Foundational runners and loops that work a plan task by task, ready for you to adapt and improve.
- 🤖 **[Any agent CLI](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/openthrottle/mcp-registration.md)**: Run plans with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity or Grok.
- 🌳 **[Worktree isolation](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/monorepo/worktree-port-allocation.md)**: Each run gets its own worktree, ports and database, so parallel agents never collide.
- 🗓️ **[Queued and scheduled runs](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/openthrottle/running-and-scheduling-plans.md)**: Run a plan now or schedule it, with guards that stop it running late or running twice.
- 🕹️ **[Steer a live run](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/skills/ot-loop/SKILL.md)**: Message a running plan mid-task and redirect it without starting over.
- 🏗️ **[Generators](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/tools/templates/AGENT_USAGE.md)**: Scaffold code in the shape your codebase expects, so agents produce predictable output.

### 📜 Work as history

Every commit carries its plan and task. Runs record the agent, model, tokens and outcome, so you can always ask what shipped and why the code exists.

- 📒 **[Work ledger](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/databases/openthrottle/README.md)**: Every commit points back to the plan and task that produced it, on a ledger you can query.
- 📊 **[Attributed token usage](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/pull/269)**: Token usage from every agent CLI, attributed to the model, the task and the billed account.
- 🧪 **[Evals](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/openthrottle/eval-system-adr.md)** _(preview)_: Evals built from real runs: datasets from failures, calibrated graders, paired comparisons.
- 🖥️ **[Developer app](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/applications/openthrottle-developer/README.md)**: A dashboard for plans, queues, pull requests, schedules and usage, plus a timeline of the work.

### 🏠 Runs on your machine

Apache-2.0 and local first: Postgres, Redis and in-process embeddings on your own machine. Cloud models and providers are optional, never required.

- 🏠 **[Runs entirely local](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/docs/monorepo/Ollama.md)**: The whole stack, embeddings included, runs on your machine. Cloud providers are optional.
- 💻 **[Desktop app](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/blob/main/applications/openthrottle-app/README.md)**: A native desktop shell around the developer app.

### On the roadmap

- **Content CMS** _(in flight)_: Schema-driven editing of fragments and layouts, with nested previews and drag-to-reorder.
- **Agent-agnostic loop job** _(in flight)_: A background loop job that drives any agent CLI with the same validation and settling.
- **Skill-usage telemetry** _(in flight)_: See which agent skills get used, how they turn out and where coverage is thin.
- **Cross-repo projects** _(planned)_: Ordered initiatives that span repositories, planned and tracked as one piece of work.
- **Specialist roles and critics** _(planned)_: Specialist agent roles and parallel critics that review each task before it lands.
- **Standalone install** _(planned)_: One download that bundles the whole stack with the desktop app.
- **Signed desktop releases** _(planned)_: A signed, notarized desktop app that updates itself.
- **Phone access** _(planned)_: Reach your own OpenThrottle from your phone, with agent runs gated behind a passkey.

## ⚙️ Installation

Setup is simple and scripted:

```bash
nvm use # or install the correct NodeJS version (see .nvmrc for the version to use)

./scripts/setup.sh
```

Then setup the MCP servers globally:

```bash
pnpm run setup:mcp-instructions
```

> [!Tip]
>
> You can run this setup script `ANYTIME` you need to **reset your environment** or resolve **setup-related issues**. See the Troubleshooting section below for common scenarios where running the setup script can help.

## 🚀 Get Started

OpenThrottle is a AI Harness built in a NX monorepo using NodeJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, NestJS, BullMQ, React Router and much more. The local stack (full walkthrough: [local-quickstart.md](./docs/openthrottle/local-quickstart.md))

1. Startup from the "openthrottle/monorepo" root

```bash
 pnpm run start
```

2. Watch the logs for the two applications to start up
1. [http://localhost:6021](http://localhost:6021) OpenThrottle Server 🧠
1. [http://localhost:6020](http://localhost:6020) OpenThrottle Developer 🏍️💨
1. Turn it off ~ _if you can..._

```bash
 pnpm run stop
```

## 🏠 Architecture

```bash
├── .env.default           # Default environment variables (in VC)
├── .agents
├── applications           # NodeJS client and server applications
├── databases              # Postgres schema, migrations, and local DB scripts
├── docs                   # Markdown documentation (see docs/)
├── infra                  # Infrastructure as code (e.g. GCP, Terraform)
├── packages               # Shared packages that can also be published
├── scripts                # Scripts to make life easier (Bash + TypeScript)
├── services               # Shared or standalone services
├── skills                 # Custom agent skills (Ralph, code review, generators, …)
└── tools                  # Nx plugins, templates, workflows (see tools/)
```

## 🚦 Project status

OpenThrottle is open core and built in the open. The table below sets expectations before you dive into any one app — everything here is Apache-2.0, but not everything is finished.

| Application              | Status      | What it is                                                                       |
| ------------------------ | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `openthrottle`           | ✅ Stable   | Quick-start / product landing (the `docker compose up` entrypoint).              |
| `openthrottle-server`    | ✅ Stable   | NestJS code-first GraphQL API — the backbone of the platform.                    |
| `openthrottle-developer` | ✅ Stable   | The flagship developer portal: plans, projects, notes, generators.               |
| `openthrottle-website`   | ✅ Stable   | Marketing site.                                                                  |
| `openthrottle-admin`     | 🧭 Planned  | Corporate management layer. On the roadmap; not production-ready.                |
| `openthrottle-workbench` | 🛠️ Internal | Storybook host for the shadcn component library. A dev tool, not a deployed app. |

> [!NOTE]
> 🧭 **Planned** and 🚧 **Experimental** apps ship as previews so you can see where OpenThrottle is headed. They build and pass CI, but aren't feature-complete — don't depend on them yet.

## 🛟 Troubleshooting

When issues arise, our goal is to provide straightforward solutions that allow you to quickly reset and restore your development environment to a working state.

**1. Build Issues?**

Sometimes you just want to start fresh, to do that:

```bash
# Stop anything that's running
pnpm run stop

# Nuke all the artifacts and node modules
pnpm run clean

# Re-install and build things
./scripts/setup.sh
```

**2. Database Issues?**

Try stopping and starting Postgres + Redis with the root pnpm scripts:

```bash
pnpm run database:stop
pnpm run database:start
```

> See [databases/openthrottle/README.md](./databases/openthrottle/README.md) and [local-quickstart.md](./docs/openthrottle/local-quickstart.md).

**3. Version mismatches?**

To see what versions of a package are installed we can use `pnpm list`. From there we typically need to set a specific resolution in our package.json. e.g. `pnpm list react`

**4. Other issues?**

Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/OpenThrottle/monorepo/issues) with what you tried and the error output, and we'll help you get unstuck.
